svg.text: Vercel Edge Global CDN, Render Cloud Compute, MongoDB Atlas Multi-AZ Cluster, and Judge0 Isolated Sandboxes

g.text: • Secure HttpOnly Cookie Storage for Auth Credentials
• HTTPS (Port 443): Initial SPA bundle fetch & REST APIs
• WSS (Port 443): Full-duplex WebSocket connection to Render
▲ «cloud» Vercel Global Edge Network (Frontend SPA Hosting & CDN)
• Split Chunks for Monaco Editor Engine
⚙️ «cloud» Render Cloud Web Service (Node.js & Express Application Server Container)
• Auth: Register, Login, Bcrypt, JWT Nonce
• Node.js vm Isolated Context with Null Prototype
• Fallback to Judge0 Cloud on Error
🍃 «cloud» MongoDB Atlas Distributed Cloud Database (Multi-AZ Replica Set)
1. users: Profiles, Bcrypt hashes, ELO ratings, streaks, battle win/loss tallies.
2. problems: Statements, tags, starter code templates, sample & hidden testcase suites.
3. submissions: Source code, runtime latency (ms), memory footprint (MB), pass/fail status.
4. battles: 6-character room codes, player references, synchronized scores, winner ID.
5. dailychallenges & tokenblacklists: 24h bonus problem scheduler & TTL automated session revocations.
• REST API over HTTPS (Port 443) with API Key Auth
• Multi-Language Compilers: C++, Java, Python, Rust, Go
• Hard Resource Bounds: 2.5s CPU Time, 128 MB RAM
• Isolated Ephemeral Container Spawn per Submission
• Active Health Probe Heartbeat Every 60 Seconds
• Local AST In-Memory Sandbox acts as Instant Fallback
Vercel Global CDN: Serverless frontend asset delivery with automatic SSL
Render Web Service: Continuous Node.js compute & persistent WebSocket daemons
MongoDB Atlas: Multi-AZ distributed replica set with zero-downtime failover
Judge0 Sandbox: Isolated containerized multi-language execution cluster
Network Topology: Zero plaintext traffic; all external egress utilizes TLS 1.3 / WSS encapsulation; database ports protected by VPC IP whitelisting.
